cues.en: Towards the end of the previous video, I mentioned a few situations in which gradient descent might not give us the correct solution or even a good solution.
cues.zh: 上一支影片快結束時，提過幾種情況，梯度下降可能無法得到正確，甚至好的解。

cues.en: In this video, I'm going to talk specifically about local minima and what local minima are, why they
cues.zh: 這支影片要專門談局部極小值：它是什麼，為什麼，

cues.en: are a problem for gradient descent algorithm in general, and why it's actually difficult to know whether this is a really serious issue in deep learning.
cues.zh: 通常會造成梯度下降的問題，以及為什麼難以判斷，這在深度學習裡是否真的很嚴重。

cues.en: Not a serious issue for the gradient descent algorithm, but whether this local minimum issue is really a problem specifically in the context of deep learning.

cues.en: So just to review a little bit of what I said in the previous video, gradient descent is guaranteed to go downhill, meaning down the error landscape.
cues.zh: 稍微複習一下，梯度下降保證會往下走，也就是沿誤差地形下降。

cues.en: However, simply going downhill does not guarantee that we will find the correct or even a good solution.
cues.zh: 但只往下走，不保證一定找到正確，甚至好的解。

cues.en: Gradient descent can get stuck in local minima if the parameters are not set right, or if we happen to start off at unfortunate starting point.
cues.zh: 如果參數沒設好，或碰巧從不利的位置開始，就可能卡在局部極小值。

cues.en: And you know when you're working in one dimension or two dimensions, it's not really an issue because you can just look, you can graph the error landscape and you can see whether we've gotten the right
cues.zh: 在一維或二維裡，這不太成問題，因為可以直接畫出誤差地形，看看得到的是正確，

cues.en: solution or a wrong solution.

cues.en: However, when you get to larger dimensions, more than two dimensions and you will start seeing when
cues.zh: 但維度超過二之後，你會在，

cues.zh: 下一節深度學習看到，這些模型的參數維度真的很高。

cues.en: So these error landscapes can be in like a 10 million dimensional space.
cues.zh: 誤差地形可能處在一千萬維空間裡。

cues.en: It is absolutely impossible to visualize them accurately and fully.

cues.zh: 就是誤差函式。

cues.en: Why does gradient descent get stuck in these minima?
cues.zh: 梯度下降為什麼會卡在這些極小值裡？

cues.en: Well, remember, the gradient descent algorithm is always going to move in the direction of the negative derivative.
cues.zh: 記得，梯度下降總是沿負導數的方向移動。

cues.zh: 假設從這裡開始。

cues.zh: 現在導數為負。

cues.en: So that means we move positive on the x axis here.
cues.zh: 所以，會往 x 軸正方向移動。

cues.en: So the derivative is negative we're moving positive.
cues.zh: 導數為負，就往正方向走。

cues.en: The derivative is negative we're moving positive here the derivative is positive.
cues.zh: 這裡也是導數負、往正方向走；但這裡導數是正的。

cues.zh: 所以往左移，就卡在這個局部極小值。

cues.zh: 很難離開，因為只要走到，

cues.en: side of this local minimum, it starts going back to the left according to the gradient descent algorithm.
cues.zh: 局部極小值的這一側，就會依梯度下降規則往左回去。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: And this is the global minimum.
cues.zh: 這裡才是全域最小值。

cues.en: This is the point we actually want to reach.
cues.zh: 是我們真正想抵達的位置。

cues.en: now again, this is a one dimensional function, so we can simply visualize it.
cues.zh: 同樣，這是一維函式，可以直接視覺化。

cues.en: We can look at it.
cues.zh: 可以看圖。

cues.en: And if the model ends up here we can say, okay, you know the model didn't do didn't get the right solution.
cues.zh: 如果模型最後停在這裡，就能說，模型沒有得到正確解。

cues.en: But in high dimensional space, we cannot visualize this error landscape in its full high dimensional representation.
cues.zh: 但高維空間裡，無法完整呈現整個誤差地形。

cues.en: So you might think it's natural to think that this is like fatal for deep learning.
cues.zh: 所以，很自然會覺得，這對深度學習是致命問題。

cues.en: How can deep learning possibly work when we have no idea if we're getting trapped in a local minimum?
cues.zh: 不知道是不是卡在局部極小值，深度學習怎麼可能有效？

cues.en: Well, you know, the enormous, incredible success of deep learning actually suggests that this isn't really a huge problem.
cues.zh: 但深度學習取得巨大、驚人的成功，其實顯示這不一定是很大的問題。

cues.en: And I will this is going to be a running theme of this course that the incredible success of deep learning and how exactly deep learning works remains a mystery.
cues.zh: 這會是整門課反覆出現的主題：深度學習的驚人成功，以及它究竟如何運作，仍然有謎團。

cues.en: It's still a bit mysterious.
cues.zh: 仍然有一點神祕。

cues.zh: 沒有人真正理解，為什麼深度學習如此有效。

cues.en: People can tell you all sorts of things.
cues.zh: 大家可以提出各種說法。

cues.en: So that already suggests that local minima are not such a huge problem.

cues.en: So it is possible that there are many good solutions.
cues.zh: 第一，可能有很多好解。

cues.en: That means many equally good local minima.
cues.zh: 也就是很多同樣好的局部極小值。

cues.en: And this interpretation, this is a possibility I don't know.
cues.zh: 這是一種可能的解讀，我不知道。

cues.en: Nobody knows if this is really true.
cues.zh: 沒有人知道，它是不是真的。

cues.en: This interpretation is consistent with the fact that you can get models with very, very different weights,

cues.zh: 仍然可以在解決問題上表現一樣好，取得很高準確率。

cues.en: So that is to say, models that deep learning models that look very different from each other have very different weights from each other, still perform equally well.

cues.en: So what we think is a problem from looking at these error functions in one dimension or two dimensions,
cues.zh: 我們看一維、二維誤差函式時，覺得是個問題，

cues.zh: 但到了非常高維的空間，真正的局部極小值，也許非常、非常少。

cues.en: And this interpretation is consistent with the complexity.

cues.en: These are equally good but distinct minima.
cues.zh: 其他都是不同、但同樣好的極小值。

cues.en: So this is a possibility.
cues.zh: 這是一種可能。

cues.en: Or it's possible that there actually aren't so many local minima in high dimensions.
cues.zh: 也可能是，高維空間裡其實沒那麼多局部極小值。

cues.en: So here we have a two dimensional function.
cues.zh: 這裡有二維函式。

cues.en: This is graphed as a surface.
cues.zh: 畫成曲面。

cues.en: And I graphed it as a surface to make it clear that there is a something called a saddle point here in the middle.

cues.en: So this is referred to as a saddle point.
cues.zh: 這叫做鞍點。

cues.en: A saddle point is where a function has a minimum in one direction and a maximum in another direction.
cues.zh: 鞍點就是，函式在某個方向為極小，另一個方向卻為極大。

cues.en: So again, this is two dimensional, but in deep learning we deal with much higher dimensions.
cues.zh: 同樣，這只是二維；深度學習處理的維度高得多。

cues.en: So what does this mean.
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: Well this means that gradient descent gets trapped.
cues.zh: 表示梯度下降會被困住，

cues.en: It gets stuck in a local minimum only if that minimum if that point is a minimum in all dimensions.
cues.zh: 卡在局部極小值，只有當那個點在所有維度都為極小時。

cues.en: So if we have a model with 400,000 parameters then we are working with an error landscape.
cues.zh: 如果模型有四十萬個參數，就會處理一個，

cues.zh: 那這種點究竟有多少？

cues.en: Okay, but as I mentioned before, we don't really know whether we are getting stuck in a local minimum.
cues.zh: 但如前所述，我們其實不知道，有沒有卡在局部極小值。

cues.en: It's hard to know for sure.

cues.en: So what to do about it?
cues.zh: 那怎麼辦？

cues.en: Well, for one thing, when the model performance is good, you just don't worry about it, you know?
cues.zh: 首先，模型表現好時，就不用太擔心。

cues.en: And when things are going well, you don't have to worry about these potential problems like local minima.
cues.zh: 一切順利時，不必為局部極小值這種潛在問題煩惱。

cues.en: Otherwise, there are a few possible solutions for local minima.
cues.zh: 否則，有幾個可能的處理方法。

cues.en: One is to retrain the model many times using different random starting weights.
cues.zh: 第一，使用不同隨機初始權重，重新訓練很多次。

cues.en: So different starting locations on the Lost Landscape.
cues.zh: 也就是從損失地形的不同位置開始。

cues.en: And then you go through all of the different.

cues.en: Maybe you run the model 20 times and you look through the performance from all 20 models, and you pick the model that does best.

cues.en: Another possible solution is to increase the dimensionality of the error landscape, which in the context of deep learning, means to have a model with more parameters.

cues.en: So you make the model a little bit more complex with the idea that it's going to have fewer local minima.

cues.en: So in this video, I told you about local minima and why local minimum can be problematic for the gradient descent algorithm.
cues.zh: 這支影片介紹了局部極小值，以及它為什麼可能造成梯度下降的問題。

cues.en: And then we also discussed that it's kind of hard to know whether the local weather, local minima is really a serious issue for deep learning.
cues.zh: 也討論了，很難知道局部極小值對深度學習究竟是不是嚴重問題。

cues.en: And I talked about possible ways that it might not be a serious issue, and what to do when you think you have some when you're getting stuck in local minima.
cues.zh: 還談了它可能不那麼嚴重的原因，以及覺得自己卡在局部極小值時，可以怎麼做。
